# UsageRunPage

The individual runs behind a range's usage, largest first by the chosen measure.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | `datetime` | The start of the range, in UTC. |
| `to` | `datetime` | The end of the range, in UTC. |
| `sort` | `string` | The measure the runs are ordered by. |
| `items` | [`UsageRunRow`](usage-run-row.md)`[]` | The runs. |
| `truncated` | `boolean` | More runs matched than were returned. |
